articles.title: Chrome Extension A/B Testing in MV3 Without Breaking Policy
articles.excerpt: Originally published on Extenify. Chrome extension A/B testing sounds simple until you hit the first wall: the Chrome Web Store reviews every code change, and Manifest V3 forbids loading code from you…
articles.body: Originally published on Extenify . Chrome extension A/B testing sounds simple until you hit the first wall: the Chrome Web Store reviews every code change, and Manifest V3 forbids loading code from your server. The good news is that a remote config that only switches between variants you already shipped is explicitly allowed by policy, and with a hashed assignment per install plus one tracked metric you can run real experiments inside a reviewed extension. The rule that makes it work: the config chooses, the package decides. Every variant's code ships in your build; the remote config only turns experiments on or off and changes their weights.

articles.title: Exec format error on a Raspberry Pi: 32-bit binary, 64-bit OS
articles.excerpt: Exec format error on Raspberry Pi — 32-bit binary, 64-bit OS Measured on a Raspberry Pi 5 running a 64-bit kernel (Linux 7.0.0-1023-raspi, uname -m = aarch64). A binary built for 32-bit ARM (armhf) do…
articles.body: Exec format error on Raspberry Pi — 32-bit binary, 64-bit OS Measured on a Raspberry Pi 5 running a 64-bit kernel (Linux 7.0.0-1023-raspi, uname -m = aarch64 ). What happens A binary built for 32-bit ARM (armhf) does not run on a 64-bit Raspberry Pi OS: $ ./mybinary bash: ./mybinary: cannot execute binary file: Exec format error The same message appears with the exec format error wording from other shells. The kernel is refusing the file because its e_machine says 32-bit ARM and this kernel has no 32-bit personality loaded for it.

articles.body: Whether you want to protect sensitive configuration files, communicate securely over public channels, or verify digital identities, PGP (Pretty Good Privacy) remains one of the gold standards of asymmetric cryptography. However, running GnuPG ( gpg ) solely through terminal flags can be intimidating for beginners. That is where Kleopatra comes in. Kleopatra is an intuitive, open-source graphical front-end for Gpg4win (on Windows) and KDE (on Linux) that makes key management, file encryption, and digital signing visual and straightforward. In this guide, you will learn how to set up Kleopatra, generate your keys, exchange public keys with collaborators, and encrypt/decrypt both text and files.

articles.title: Beyond the Jira Jockey: The True Role of an Exceptional Scrum Master
articles.excerpt: What is the True Role of a Scrum Master? The true role of a Scrum Master is to build a team so autonomous, resilient, and high-performing that their own daily presence becomes unnecessary. They act as…
articles.body: What is the True Role of a Scrum Master? The true role of a Scrum Master is to build a team so autonomous, resilient, and high-performing that their own daily presence becomes unnecessary. They act as servant leaders who remove systemic organizational blockers, coach self-organization, and shift the team's focus from tracking output to delivering tangible business outcomes. If a Scrum Master is just managing Jira tickets or acting as a 15-minute timer during Daily Standups, they are failing the team. Let me be blunt. I have walked into countless sprint rooms where the Scrum Master is treated like a glorified administrative assistant. They update the board, ping developers for status updates, and take meeting minutes. This is a massive organizational anti-pattern.

articles.title: Alpine didn't break your Vite build. A missing optional dependency did.
articles.excerpt: Alpine didn't break your Vite build. A missing optional dependency did. The advice is everywhere in Docker threads: if a Node build fails on Alpine, switch to Debian. I tested that claim against a rea…
articles.body: Alpine didn't break your Vite build. A missing optional dependency did. The advice is everywhere in Docker threads: if a Node build fails on Alpine, switch to Debian. I tested that claim against a real Vite 7 / React 19 / Tailwind 4 app. Alpine was innocent. The test Same source, four setups, one question: does the build produce a working bundle? Setup node_modules/@rollup Build node:22-alpine , npm install rollup-linux-x64-musl ✅ passes node:22-alpine , npm ci with a lockfile generated on Debian rollup-linux-x64-gnu , rollup-linux-x64-musl ✅ passes node:22-alpine , npm install --omit=optional (empty) ❌ fails immediately node:22-bookworm-slim , npm ci rollup-linux-x64-gnu , rollup-linux-x64-musl ✅ passes A clean install on musl builds a React app without complaint.

Xfinity says it saw a jump in Xbox hardware traffic four times more than normal around the time GTA 6 became available in New Zealand. Although Xfinity provides its services in the United States, Xbox users were able to take advantage of a loophole that let them change their console's region to New Zealand, allowing them start playing the game early despite their actual geographic location. It's one of the only real notable advantages Xbox has had over PlayStation with this game, as Rockstar secured a marketing deal to advertise GTA 6 as playing best on PS5. However, these hours of early access have proven to be very lucrative for Xbox players.

articles.body: Rockstar Games has revealed why they chose to forego the ability to pick up prostitutes in GTA 6 . That's right — GTA 6 doesn't let you pick up ladies of the night when you're feeling lonely anymore. No, the reason isn't because the game has "gone woke" or anything like that; instead, it's for narrative purposes. As you may already know, Rockstar has put the focus of GTA 6 on a couple. The entire story largely hinges on the romantic pair at the very least having an interest of pursuing a relationship with each other, if not being madly in love, should the player take them down that road. articles.body: Astronomers may have, for the first time ever, directly witnessed a star engulfing its companion, a new study reports. As stars die, they swell up to hundreds of times their original size, consuming anything orbiting nearby. In a binary star system, this can include a dying star merging with its companion star. However, scientists had never directly seen any examples of such a cosmic drama unfolding — until now. "Catching a star engulfing its companion in the act is very difficult," study lead author Viraj Karambelkar, an astrophysicist at Columbia University in New York, told Space.com. "When a star engulfs its companion, its effect is very subtle — like throwing a bucket of water in a large ocean.

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 18, 2013: NASA launches MAVEN spacecraft to Mars to find out how the Red Planet lost its water
articles.excerpt: On Nov. 18, 2013, NASA launched the MAVEN spacecraft to Mars to investigate the planet's missing water. Here's why it mattered.
articles.body: On Nov. 18, 2013, NASA launched the MAVEN spacecraft to Mars. The name of NASA's MAVEN spacecraft stands for Mars Atmosphere and Volatile EvolutioN. The spacecraft was an orbiter designed to help scientists figure out what happened to the water on Mars and its atmosphere. Mars is dry today, but it data from several Mars missions suggest that it was a much wetter environment a long time ago. MAVEN tracked the rate of atmospheric loss from Mars . The planet has a super thin atmosphere that has been leaking into space for a few billion years. Scientists think that when Mars lost its atmosphere, water dried up on the surface as a result. Solar storms that blast radiation into the solar system appear to have blasted away some of the atmosphere.
